entities.summary: Eric Ross Weinstein is an American investor and financial executive. As of 2021, he was managing director for the American venture capital firm Thiel Capital. Weinstein has hosted a podcast called The Portal, coined the term "intellectual dark web", and has proposed a theory of everything called "Geometric Unity" that has largely been ignored or met with skepticism in the scientific community.
